paragraphs: Here is the weather report for this week. On Monday, it is sunny and warm. The temperature is 25 degrees. On Tuesday, it is cloudy but dry. On Wednesday, it is rainy and cool.
The weather is different in each season. Spring is warm and wet. Summer is hot. Autumn is cool and dry. Winter is cold and snowy.

The Smiths want to go on a trip this weekend. They ask, "Could you please tell us the weather on Saturday?" The weatherman says, "On Saturday, it will be sunny and windy. It is a good day for a picnic."
It is far from their home to the park, but they are happy. They will take a trip and enjoy the weekend.

opts: "Could you please tell us the weather on Saturday?"

questions.q: What will the weather be like on Saturday?
What is the passage mainly about?
opts: How to make a weather report.
The weather and a vacation plan.
How to go on a trip.

paragraphs: The summer vacation is coming. Amy and her family plan a trip to the beach. "How's the weather in summer?" Amy asks her mother. "It's hot and sunny," her mother says. "But the sea is cool and lovely."

Amy wants to bring many things. She says, "Could I take my new sunglasses?" Her mother says, "Sure, go ahead." Amy also asks, "Would you please buy some drinks for the trip?" Her mother says, "No problem."
On the day of the trip, it is a sunny day. It is far from their home to the beach, so they drive early. At the beach, Amy plays in the water and makes a sandcastle. She is very happy.
It is time to go home in the evening. Amy says, "The trip is wonderful. I love summer vacation!" Her family smiles. They will take another trip next year.

How's the weather in summer?
What does Amy say to ask for permission?
How do they go to the beach?
What does Amy do at the beach?
opts: She plays in the water and makes a sandcastle.
She goes swimming in the sea.

reading_c.provenance: 真题母本改编（教师授权原创 2026-08-08）
reading_c.绑定: G40 天气句型 / G42 非人称 It / 四季科普
paragraphs: There are four seasons in a year: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Each season has different weather.
In spring, it is warm and wet. Flowers bloom and trees turn green. Many people like spring because it is not too hot or too cold.
In summer, it is hot. The temperature is often over 30 degrees. Children like summer because they have a long vacation. They can go swimming.
In autumn, it is cool and dry. The leaves turn yellow and red. It is a good time for a trip. Many people climb mountains.
In winter, it is cold and snowy. The temperature is often below zero degrees. Children like winter because they can make snowmen and go skating.
It is important to check the weather before you go out. Put on warm clothes in cold days and take an umbrella on rainy days. Enjoy every season!

questions.q: How many seasons are there in a year?
Which season is warm and wet?
Why do children like summer?
opts: Because they have a long vacation.

questions.q: What should we do before we go out?
What is the passage mainly about?
opts: The four seasons and their weather.

sa.title: 阅读表达
sa.passage_title: A Nice Day for a Trip
sa.绑定: 天气表达/Could-Would请求/非人称 It
paragraphs: A Nice Day for a Trip
It is a sunny day today. The weather is warm and the sky is blue. Tom and his family want to go on a trip to the mountains.
Tom asks his mother, "Could you please make some sandwiches?" His mother says, "Of course." Tom also asks his father, "Would you please bring a camera?" His father says, "No problem."
They drive to the mountains. It is far from their home, but the trip is fun. At the top of the mountain, it is cool and windy. They have a picnic and take many pictures.
It is time to go home in the evening. Tom says, "What a wonderful trip! I love the mountains."

questions.answer: He asks her to make some sandwiches.

questions.q: What is the weather like at the top of the mountain?
请把文中画线句子翻译成汉语（It is a sunny day today.）
questions.answer: 今天是一个晴朗的日子。

writing.title: 书面表达
writing.prompt:
假如你是李华，请你用英语写一篇90词左右的短文，介绍你最喜欢的季节和你的度假计划。内容包括：
1. 你最喜欢的季节是哪个、那里的天气怎么样；
2. 你为什么喜欢这个季节（用 because 说明）；
3. 在这个季节里你想去哪里、做什么（用 Could/Would you please... 提出至少一个请求）。
sample: My favorite season is spring. The weather is warm and wet. It is not too hot or too cold. The flowers bloom and the trees turn green.

I like spring because it is the best time for a trip. I want to go on a trip to the countryside with my family. I say, "Could you please make a picnic for us?" My mother says, "Of course." I also say, "Would you please bring a camera?" My father says, "No problem."
In spring, the sky is blue and the air is fresh. I love the beautiful weather. I hope we will have a wonderful trip.
writing.requirements: 1. 词数约 90 词；2. 包含所有提示要点；3. 语句通顺，意思连贯，语法正确；4. 可适当发挥。
